_doc: Configuration of the medfig CT pipeline (head CT: the bone ring and the brain, no scalp). Units: mm in MNI152 space unless the key or this note says otherwise. HU: Hounsfield units. In raster and vector, pixels (px) are 0.5 mm (the grid of the MRI planes file). mask_round_sigma, suture_close_px, cut_pad_px and dp_epsilon are in pixels; erode_vox is in voxels of the CT volume. contour_sigma and min_contour_points are in contour points. pad_units, roi_units, outline_width and the screen values are in frame units; one frame unit is unit_mm. In stack_3d, px are CSS pixels of the page. orientation: radiological (the left of the patient on the right of the image, as in clinical viewers) or neurological (left on the left, as in the WSI figure).

hu._doc: Thresholds on the CT template. The intracranial mask is made in 3D by `ct extract` and stored in the planes file: voxels in soft_window are eroded by erode_vox, the largest part is kept and grown back by erode_vox + 1 voxels inside grow_from <= HU < bone, then holes are filled along each axis. bone: HU above it is bone. csf: inside the intracranial mask, HU below it is CSF (ventricles, cisterns).

figures._doc: Report figures only (ct figures). Grey windows of the HU panels, in HU. example_k: the slice of the worked example (MEDFIG_CT_EXAMPLE overrides it).
